title: The Narrow street behind the market
subtitle: 城市生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）
meta: 主题语境：城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）　|　核心词汇：narrow　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 narrow 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1987 the headmaster wrote of ① a narrow street behind the market in the record, and everybody in the school said at once that it was ② narrower than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the headmaster, who never explained anything, had done it on the same day and gone home; it was the narrow ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the narrowest street behind the market anybody in the school had ever seen, or so the record for October 1981 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too narrow to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the student who had come to help; the narrow ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bell at the far gate, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a narrow escape from the flood, and said that no student in his right mind would call it ⑥ as narrow as the escape from the flood they had once had in the old school. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was narrow or not, and he said so.

By 1994 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the record. What the line asked for was ⑦ something narrow, and nothing besides. The student from the next school called the whole plan ⑧ quite narrow; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the record kept the names of the narrow ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1997, before dawn, she wrote of another narrow street behind the market in the same record, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ narrower than anybody had expected. ⑩ The narrowest escape from the flood in the whole school, she said in 1999, was the one she could never quite name; the narrow ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 狭窄（前置定语 a narrow street behind the market：1987 年校长在学籍册里记下的那件狭窄的小巷）
B. adj. 狭窄／勉强（比较级 narrower than：文中两处，一处比集市后身的小巷，一处比预想）
C. adj. 狭窄／勉强（最高级 the narrowest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 狭窄（表语 too narrow to do：母亲觉得它太狭窄，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 勉强（前置定语 a narrow escape from the flood：叔叔把整件事称作一桩勉强的从洪水中勉强脱身）
F. adj. 勉强（同级比较 as narrow as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩从洪水中勉强脱身相比）
G. adj. 勉强（后置定语 something narrow：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 勉强（受程度副词修饰 quite narrow：那位学生的评价）

items.q: a narrow street behind the market
the narrowest street behind the market anybody
a narrow escape from the flood
The narrowest escape from the flood in

answers.why: narrow 意为“狭窄”，1987 年校长在学籍册里记下的是“一件狭窄的小巷”，此处作前置定语 a narrow street behind the market。
narrow 意为“狭窄”，此处用比较级 narrower than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
narrow 意为“狭窄”，学籍册上 十月 那行字说它是学堂里最狭窄的一件，故用最高级 the narrowest street behind the market。
narrow 意为“狭窄”，母亲认为这件东西“太狭窄了，谁也用不上”，too narrow to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
narrow 意为“勉强”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩勉强的从洪水中勉强脱身”，此处作前置定语 a narrow escape from the flood。
narrow 意为“勉强”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩从洪水中勉强脱身一样勉强”，同级比较用 as narrow as。
narrow 意为“勉强”，学籍册上那半行字要的是“勉强的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something narrow。
narrow 意为“勉强”，邻学堂来的那位学生认为这套计划“相当勉强”，quite 修饰原级 narrow。
narrow 意为“勉强”，1997 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要勉强”，故用比较级 narrower than。
narrow 意为“勉强”，母亲 1999 年说的是“整个学堂里最勉强的那一桩”，故用最高级 the narrowest escape from the flood。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1987 年，校长在学籍册里记下了一件狭窄的小巷。（a narrow street behind the market）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更狭窄。（narrower than …）
母亲觉得它太狭窄，谁也用不上。（too narrow to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩勉强的从洪水中勉强脱身。（a narrow escape from the flood）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩从洪水中勉强脱身一样勉强。（as narrow as …）
到了 1994 年，学籍册上只剩半行字：要的是一件勉强的东西。（something narrow）
answers: In 1987 the headmaster wrote of a narrow street behind the market in the record.
Everybody said it was narrower than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too narrow to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a narrow escape from the flood.
He said nobody would call it as narrow as the escape from the flood they had once had.
By 1994 the record asked for nothing but something narrow.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 narrow 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1987 the headmaster wrote of a narrow street behind the market in the record, and nobody forgot it.
It was the narrowest street behind the market in the school, or so the record says.
My mother thought it too narrow to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a narrow escape from the flood, and nobody argued with him.
The student from the next school called the plan quite narrow, and everybody laughed.
The narrow ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
